name: Invictus

features.name: Pantheon Multipliers
features.description: Row multipliers, with right-side values revealed by full-width wins.

features.name: Olympian Respins
features.description: Premium wins stick while the rest respins.

review:
A Roman arena with two systems. Pantheon Multipliers sit on both sides of the grid – a win from a row gets that row's multiplier. The left ones are always visible; the right ones only reveal when a five-symbol win crosses the whole grid.

Olympian Respins hold any premium or wild win in place and respin the rest, for as long as those wins keep growing. The Temple of Jupiter bonus improves the multiplier odds. 10,000x max, with great gladiator art.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen

Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
